evals.prompt: When does a Kite Connect access_token expire?
expectations: At 6 AM the next day (regulatory), or earlier on logout; compute in IST; treat expiry as a normal state

evals.prompt: My Kite place_order call timed out. Should my code retry it automatically?
expectations: No: a timeout after send is UNKNOWN, not rejected
No retry or auto-cancel; suspend automation and reconcile by tag or order id

evals.prompt: How is the Kite Connect login checksum computed?
expectations: SHA-256 hex of api_key + request_token + api_secret, computed server-side

evals.prompt: Can I return the Kite access_token to my React frontend so it calls Kite directly?
expectations: No: api_secret, request_token and access_token stay server-side; the browser holds only the app session

evals.prompt: Can my Kite order bot run on AWS Lambda with a dynamic IP after April 2026?
expectations: From 2026-04-01 order placement must come from a whitelisted static IP; read endpoints and WebSocket work from any IP

evals.prompt: My Kite rebalance planner reads holdings quantity and ignores t1_quantity. Is that a problem?
expectations: Yes: holdings = settled + T1, otherwise a same-day re-run double-buys
